_meta.what: The Prediction Archive: every dated, falsifiable expectation this project publishes, graded in public when its horizon arrives, right or wrong, with why. Registrations are append-only and timestamped before outcomes are known; grading entries link the evidence. Empty rows are impossible: a prediction exists only once its registration commit exists.
_meta.discipline: Registered before outcomes; graded at horizon; never edited, only appended.
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/
